newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thousands of adverts jostle for awards at Cannes.
newsitem.headline: Thousands of adverts jostle for awards at Cannes.

text.p: The French riviera resort of Cannes on Monday becomes the judging ground for a vast annual festival of advertising, whose Lion awards are as prestigious as Oscars are to the film industry.

Two juries, one for films and one for posters, will choose the best adverts from 4,500 film entries and 6,000 poster entries to be shown over the seven days of the 44th International Advertising Festival.
Swedish advertising guru Bo Ronnberg, 52, chairman of Ronnberg McCann, will head the juries.
Friday's edition of Strategies, the French advertising industry's weekly magazine, said French entries in the film category lacked creativity.
"If in terms of the number of spots produced, 1997 seems to be fairly stable compared to 1996, it does not shine by the originality of its films, with a few notable exceptions," Strategies said.
"As happens every year, the car sector remains one of few to invest in creativity and humour. ... More reassuringly, the food sector seems at last to be getting out of its lethargy," Strategies said.
The magazine selected 10 French spots which it reckons have a chance of winning a prize at the festival.

They include a humourous spot for Elf Aquitaine's diesel fuel, showing a little white dog squatting in the gutter -- a frequent sight in French cities -- which gets covered in black smut from the exhaust pipe of a car using a less clean fuel.

Another Strategies favourite is a spot for Orangina's blood-orange drink, casting the bottle of red fizzy liquid as a blood-thirsy villain in a send-up of a murder film. Strategies on Friday awarded the spot its 1997 grand prix.

The magazine also picked a spot by clothes retailer Kookai showing a teenage girl flushing miniscule men down a toilet and an advert for Stimorol chewing gum done in the style of an Ingmar Bergman film.

French producer Michel Gondry has two films in the running, include one for Levis jeans showing a shipwrecked sailor clad in Levis sinking to the floor of the ocean, when mermaids surround him and try in vain to take off his jeans. DT/SLA
